Automatic Stand feature, 7th level.

Out of your sight, the stand turns Autonomous: it stops sharing damage with you and has its own Hit Points equal to 5 × your level (damage to it doesn't reach you). It gains +2 to saves and resistance to all damage equal to twice your level (half that against force, spirit and ghost touch). It's immune to mental, fear and death effects, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{stunned}. Its Strikes gain +3 to hit and roll damage dice equal to your level (minimum 8), and it never retreats. When destroyed, it reforms at the start of its own next turn with half its Hit Points. Starving the program: if no creature matching its program is within its 60-foot program sense at the start of its turn, it is dormant and does nothing that turn; after 2 dormant turns in a row it unmanifests. The user: if you are knocked out, killed or forced to call it off, it loses these benefits and unmanifests.
